title: Serve European text selector roots from extracted data
platforms: European ROM and Windows interpreter under Wine
changes: e315-d314 adds the 192 missing source-root words for the complete declared localized text and name-keyboard selector family. Existing literal ownership and the 155 other resource records remain intact.
validation: Windows build yzvvmwvk passed and preserved the exact E503 executable. One Wine test wmqakvh1 verified 197 original source-root cells and six fallback cases. Both machine variants returned the same pointers and matched registers, flags and guest clock with the 768 new backing bytes inverted. Preparation, reuse, verification, e314-d313 attachment and rehashed-edit rejection passed. Wine drained.
limitations: Scope is original selector and keyboard load instructions in the interpreter. Ordinary startup and game scenes, stored RAM-fed arguments, translated execution, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
The effective GPT-6.1 Terra xhigh setting could not be independently confirmed.
